name: sql-atlas
description: Local SQL diagnostics for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server and Oracle.

walkthroughs.title: Find risky SQL before it ships
walkthroughs.description: Run your first local SQL analysis in under a minute.

steps.title: Try a realistic SQL sample
steps.description: Run [Open Interactive Sample](command:sqlAtlas.openSample) and see diagnostics directly in the editor.

steps.title: Understand the findings
steps.description: Open the Problems panel with [Show Problems](command:workbench.actions.view.problems). Each finding includes a rule ID and a concrete suggestion.

steps.title: Match your database
steps.description: Choose PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server or Oracle in [SQL Atlas Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%40ext%3AMilosz.sql-atlas).

sqlAtlas.minimumSeverity.description: Lowest finding severity shown in the editor.

sqlAtlas.ignoreRules.description: SQL Atlas rule IDs disabled for this workspace.
